title: Lipschitz continuity under linear contraction
statement: Let $E$ be a real normed vector space, let $D:E\to\mathcal L(E,\mathbb R)$ be Lipschitz with constant $C\ge0$, and let $L:E\to E$ be continuous linear with operator norm at most $1$. Then the map $x\mapsto D(Lx)\circ L$ is Lipschitz with constant $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is a real normed vector space
replaced: Let $E$ be a real normed vector space, $D:E\to\mathcal L(E,\mathbb R)$ be $C$-Lipschitz in operator norm with $C\ge0$, and $L:E\to E$ be continuous linear with $\|L\|\le1$. Then $x\mapsto D(Lx)\circ L$ is $C$-Lipschitz.
